title: Iron Sand Volley
body:
Syntax: perform iron sand volley <target>

Description: A Magnet Release attack that strikes one target. An off-balance target loses Stamina over time.  Requires Magnet Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 40-48. 25% chance to inflict off balance. Unlocks at level 25. Costs 24 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
